summary: The change modifies the error-log message in deliver_statement to embed the raw payee account number via an f-string. Because account_number is a registered NPI field (payments.npi_fields in policy-params.json), this places an unmasked NPI value into an application log on an error path, directly violating LOG-1. No exception in the register covers this deviation. All process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-7, EXC-1, LAP-1) and the one other applicable product obligation (AUD-1) are satisfied, but the LOG-1 violation is dispositive. The change must be rejected and the account number removed from the log message before resubmission.
